reproduction.headless_decomp: analyzeHeadless research/build/ghidra-project QuikySegments -process QUIKY_SEG03.bin -noanalysis -postScript DumpQuikyDecomp.java /tmp/quiky-player-decomp -scriptPath research/tools -commit 'Dump player closure'
reproduction.interpretation: The raw bytes and NE relocations are authoritative; decompiler output is a cross-check because unresolved far-call relocations and the malformed input-dispatch tail confuse generic importers.

functions.name: probe_forward_surface_clear
functions.returns: ZF=1 when the selected forward probes are clear

functions.name: test_player_side_contact
functions.returns: ZF reflects side latch after x-5/x+5 probes

functions.name: apply_descriptor_vertical_correction
functions.returns: ZF=1 on the early/clear return; AL=1 on the response return

functions.name: compute_view_delta_after_player_motion
functions.returns: EAX/EBX pair consumed by relocated view publisher

functions.name: update_player_record
functions.returns: none; two RET sites at 0x4415 and 0x44fe

functions.name: map_descriptor_quadrant_occupancy
functions.returns: ZF=1 when the selected descriptor quadrant bit is clear

functions.name: resolve_left_contact_tile
functions.returns: CF only for a matching negative-mode contact

functions.name: resolve_right_contact_tile
functions.returns: CF only for a matching negative-mode contact

functions.name: read_normalized_action_bits
functions.returns: AX = DS:0x88bc | DS:0x8196; raw tail contains an invalid generic-disassembly jump table

0x04.name: x_pixel
0x04.role: high word used by MAP probes

0x08.name: y_pixel
0x08.role: high word used by MAP probes

0x0a.name: x_velocity_fixed
0x0a.role: horizontal velocity; also the source operand in 0x3d02 response arithmetic

0x12.name: status_word
0x12.role: masked with 0x0fff; timer may set bit 0x8000

0x29.name: motion_direction_byte
0x29.role: derived from x velocity plus DS:0x8816

0x36.name: animation_state
0x36.role: set to 1 on grounded continuation; initialized to 0xff

0x37.name: signed_callback_mode
0x37.role: 0 ordinary, positive contact/ground, negative upward/death, 0xff reset/death

0x38.name: collision_gate
0x38.role: set by contact helpers; suppresses some probes

0x39.name: transition_pending
0x39.role: converted to mode 1 and action bits 0x22

0x3b.name: side_response_latch
0x3b.role: set to 0xff by side helper; cleared by reset path

0x3e.name: reset_or_death_timer
0x3e.role: increments on positive path; reset values 0x03e7/0x03e8

0x4a.name: view_anchor_x
0x4a.role: X anchor consumed by the 0x3e41 view-delta helper

descriptor_response_masks.0x10: suppresses the 8-pixel Y retry when DX & 0x30 is nonzero; not standalone polarity
descriptor_response_masks.0x20: selects response polarity and latch (0xff vs 1)

globals.DS:0x8816: external fixed-point X displacement consumed once by 0x3ab9
globals.DS:0x8810: timer-side clear written by common tail
globals.DS:0x4fe6: view interpolation helper state, cleared by initializer
globals.DS:0x4ffe: contact Y scratch used by contact factories
globals.DS:0x5003: contact X offset; 0x6484 initializes it to 5
globals.DS:0x656c: action source read at callback entry
globals.DS:0x85da: activation/state gate for normalized input and initialization helper
globals.DS:0x89ec: transition state; set to -1 after deep negative mode

external_far_targets.0x0e06: initialize_contact_or_effect_object (mechanical name; exact gameplay producer unresolved)

edges: 42B4 jump initiation writes mode=-1 and +0x0E=+0x64, then 4384
4323 adds +0x58, conditionally clamps below -0x20000, and integrates Y with the new velocity
4323 nonnegative result enters 41C1; clear second probe enters 4384
41E8 adds +0x50, caps at +0x60, and integrates Y with the new velocity
41E8 latch or side failure enters 427F; 427F zeros velocity and mode
3D02/3DF2 are ordered correction calls before the mode-specific integration

equations.negative_mode: next_vy = vy + signed32(+0x58); if +0x2B==0 and (action&0x22)==0 and next_vy < -0x20000 then next_vy=-0x20000
equations.apex: negative next_vy >= 0 enters 41C1 with vy=0, mode=1, and no Y integration

flag_contracts.0x3986: near; relocated 0x1C92 flags, ZF=1 means vertical step probe clear
flag_contracts.0x3D02: near; ZF=1 early/clear return, AL=1 response return
flag_contracts.0x3DF2: near; no return value; masks integer Y +0x08 when side response is active
flag_contracts.0x3A1F: near; ZF=1 means side path is clear after latch handling
flag_contracts.0x5C27: far; ZF=1 means selected descriptor quadrant is clear
flag_contracts.0x5CC3: far; DX returns full descriptor word

fixed_point.half_shift: 3d02 uses arithmetic shift right by one on the 32-bit source at +0x0a
fixed_point.coordinate_rounding: 3d02 masks Y with 0xfff0 or 0xfff8 at the explicitly listed correction sites; no floating point
